result.title: SO(3)-Equivariant Learning on CAD Boundary Representations
result.summary: Learning on boundary representations (B-reps) requires robustness to the pose of a part, since CAD models are not stored in a canonical orientation. Existing B-rep networks either operate on world-frame coordinates and normals, and thus degrade under rotation, or encode each face in a local reference frame. Local frames yield invariance, but reduce inter-face messages to scalars and discard the relative orientation of adjacent faces. We propose SO3brep, an SO(3)-equivariant graph neural network on the B-rep face-adjacency graph. Node features are computed in local frames and mapped into a shared frame by Wigner D-matrices. Clebsch-Gordan tensor products couple these features with the directions between adjacent faces, so that relative orientation is preserved throughout message passing and the output remains SE(3)-invariant. Across three face-segmentation and two classification benchmarks with randomly rotated test parts, SO3brep achieves the highest accuracy among the compared B-rep networks and equivariant point cloud networks, with the fewest parameters. Its advantage is largest with few labeled parts, a setting typical of industrial CAD. Code is available at https://github.com/UGent-CVAMO/so3brep.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SO3brep：在 B-rep 面邻接图上构建 SO(3) 等变图网络，节点特征在局部坐标系中计算后用 Wigner D 矩阵映射到共享坐标系，并通过 Clebsch-Gordan 张量积与相邻面间方向耦合，使消息传递保留相对朝向、输出保持 SE(3) 不变，在旋转测试的面分割与分类基准上取得最佳精度且参数量最少。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线关系较远，但其用等变消息传递在状态更新中显式保留几何相对朝向的做法，可供核查能否类比用于视觉几何关系在 latent 推理状态中的保持与不丢失。
